evidence.observation: Post-purge oxygen was low at 1.6 ppm before growth.
Oxygen continued rising to 18.7 ppm despite unchanged temperature and argon setpoints.
Oxygen reached 25.3 ppm, a sustained increase inconsistent with the preceding stable low-oxygen atmosphere.
Temperature 749.5 °C and argon 100.3 sccm track setpoints; heater power is stable at 43.8% and controller reports running, neither of which rules out an atmosphere fault.
Pressure gauge is not installed; null pressure telemetry cannot establish pressure or exhaust behavior.

args.missing_evidence: Independent oxygen verification, a leak-integrity check, and pressure/exhaust-flow measurements are needed to distinguish air ingress from exhaust restriction, oxygen release, or sensor error; sample characterization is not yet available.
